```{python}
#| label: fig-esd-io-protection
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "ESD protection of a bidirectional digital I/O pad: the primary diodes $D_1$/$D_2$ carry the main discharge current to the rails, the series resistor $R_\\mathrm{in}$ limits the current into the secondary diodes $D_3$/$D_4$, which protect the gate oxide of the input receiver; the output driver $M_\\mathrm{P}$/$M_\\mathrm{N}$ is decoupled from the pad by the small drain series resistance $R_\\mathrm{s}$; the power clamp closes the discharge loop between $V_\\mathrm{DD}$ and $V_\\mathrm{SS}$. All protection elements are off in normal operation."

import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=10)

    # rails
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((0, 6), (13.4, 6)).label(
        '$V_\\mathrm{DD}$', loc='left')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((0, 0), (13.4, 0)).label(
        '$V_\\mathrm{SS}$', loc='left')

    # power clamp
    d += elm.Zener().endpoints((1, 0), (1, 6)).label('power\nclamp',
                                                     loc='top')
    d += elm.Dot().at((1, 6))
    d += elm.Dot().at((1, 0))

    # output driver
    mp = elm.PFet(bulk=False).at((3, 4.5)).anchor('gate').theta(0).reverse()
    d += mp.label('$M_\\mathrm{P}$', loc='right', ofst=(-0.3, 0))
    mn = elm.NFet(bulk=False).at((3, 1.5)).anchor('gate').theta(0).reverse()
    d += mn.label('$M_\\mathrm{N}$', loc='right', ofst=(-0.3, 0))

    x_drv = mp.absanchors['drain'][0]
    d += elm.Line().at(mp.absanchors['source']).to((x_drv, 6))
    d += elm.Dot().at((x_drv, 6))
    d += elm.Line().at(mn.absanchors['source']).to((x_drv, 0))
    d += elm.Dot().at((x_drv, 0))
    d += elm.Line().at(mp.absanchors['drain']).to((x_drv, 3))
    d += elm.Line().at(mn.absanchors['drain']).to((x_drv, 3))
    d += elm.Dot().at((x_drv, 3))

    # driver gates from the core
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((3, 4.5), (3, 1.5))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((2.4, 3), (3, 3))
    d += elm.Dot().at((3, 3))
    d += elm.Label().at((2.0, 3)).label('from\ncore')

    # drain series resistance and pad
    d += elm.Resistor().endpoints((x_drv, 3), (6.15, 3)).label(
        '$R_\\mathrm{s}$')
    d += elm.Rect(corner1=(6.15, 2.75), corner2=(6.65, 3.25)).at((0, 0))
    d += elm.Label().at((6.4, 3.65)).label('PAD')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((6.65, 3), (7.4, 3))

    # primary diodes
    d += elm.Diode().endpoints((7.4, 3), (7.4, 6)).label('$D_1$',
                                                         loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Diode().endpoints((7.4, 0), (7.4, 3)).label('$D_2$',
                                                         loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Dot().at((7.4, 3))
    d += elm.Dot().at((7.4, 6))
    d += elm.Dot().at((7.4, 0))

    # series resistor
    d += elm.Resistor().endpoints((7.4, 3), (9.9, 3)).label(
        '$R_\\mathrm{in}$')
    d += elm.Dot().at((9.9, 3))

    # secondary diodes
    d += elm.Diode().endpoints((9.9, 3), (9.9, 6)).label('$D_3$',
                                                         loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Diode().endpoints((9.9, 0), (9.9, 3)).label('$D_4$',
                                                         loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Dot().at((9.9, 6))
    d += elm.Dot().at((9.9, 0))

    # receiver (triangle symbol)
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((9.9, 3), (11, 3))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((11, 3.8), (11, 2.2))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((11, 3.8), (12.4, 3))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((11, 2.2), (12.4, 3))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((12.4, 3), (13.2, 3))
    d += elm.Label().at((11.6, 4.1)).label('receiver')
    d += elm.Label().at((13.6, 3)).label('to\ncore')
```
